'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Garden Grove gas leak]]
**A chemical tank containing {{cvt|7000|USgal|liters|abbr=on}} of [[methyl methacrylate]] at the [[GKN Aerospace]] facility in [[Garden Grove, California|Garden Grove]], [[California]], [[United States]], overheats and is on the verge of [[chemical accident|exploding]]. Over 40,000 residents in the nearby area are ordered to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]] as response teams do not have a novel solution to prevent the tank from cracking or entering [[thermal runaway]]. [https://ktla.com/news/orange-county/thousands-evacuated-again-after-toxic-tank-leak-in-garden-grove/ (KTLA-5)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/may/22/california-orange-county-chemical-tank (''The Guardian'')]

*At least nine people are killed and nine others are injured when a building collapses in [[Fez, Morocco|Fez]], [[Morocco]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/four-people-killed-building-collapse-moroccos-fez-authorities-say-2026-05-21/ (Reuters)]

*[[2026 Central Africa Ebola epidemic|2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**[[Africa–India relations]]
***[[India]] and the [[African Union]] postpone the upcoming [[India–Africa Forum Summit]], originally scheduled to be held in [[New Delhi]] between May 28 and 31, due to the [[Ebola]] outbreak in parts of [[Africa]]. [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/lifestyle/south-korea-india-thailand-raise-ebola-alerts-as-outbreak-spreads-3220425?s=3 (''Türkiye'')] [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20260521004600315 (Yonhap)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in the United States]]
**[[Capital punishment in Alabama]]
***''[[Hamm v. Smith]]''
****The [[U.S. Supreme Court]] dismisses an appeal by the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Alabama]] challenging a lower court decision to block the execution of Joseph Clifton Smith, an [[Intellectual disability|intellectually disabled]] man convicted of a 1997 [[Murder in United States law|murder]]. The court says that executing Smith would violate his [[Constitution of the United States|constitutional]] rights. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/may/21/supreme-court-hamm-v-smith-death-penalty-intellectual-disability (''The Guardian'')]
